newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 6.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 6.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Three oppostion parties will appeal to the Constitutional Court against a new rule under which leaders of the Social Security Self-Governments will be delegated, not elected.
- It is certain that some members of parliament will defect from the Christian-Democrat Party, Vice-President Tibor Fuzessy said.
- Finance Minister Peter Medgyessy has acknowledged that small and medium-size firms are disadvantaged in business competition.
- Prime Minister Gyula Horn said he is ready to consider future cooperation with all democratic parties and he considers as such all parties in parliament.
- Magda Kosane Kovacs, deputy leader of the Socialist Party said that for a possible coalition more coomon ground is needed and that restricts the number of possible allies.
